method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the claimant whose claim before a court or arbitrator in Victoria is governed by the law of another State, a Territory or New Zealand, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05; dates in one module, the rules and the claimant's exported questions in another (each question calls a rule defined beside it), worked cases in a third; one regulative rule (s 5, the other place's limitation period) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

seat: the claimant: the person who brings a claim before a court or an arbitrator in Victoria where the law of another State, a Territory or New Zealand governs it, typically a person injured interstate who sues in Victoria (clpa-claimant.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run clpa-dates.l4 ; l4 run clpa-claimant.l4 ; l4 run clpa-cases-claimant.l4
checks.result: 83 assertions written, 83 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: The whole Act. In: s 2 (as the day s 4 counts from), s 3, s 4, s 5, s 6, and what s 5 means in days for the claimant (in time or not under the other place's period, and the last day), with that period, its starting day and any extension asked as facts. Out: s 1 (purpose); the other place's limitation law itself (not deposited); the choice of law that decides which place's law governs (asked); Victoria's own limitation law and the limitation laws of countries other than New Zealand (the Act is silent). Reasons in NOTES.md.
questions: Does the Act reach my proceeding
Whose limitation law applies to my claim
How will the court use a discretion under that law
Am I in time under that place's limitation law
By when must I start my claim
